statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains at 24 because the verified Kharg tanker-strike report and continuing Gulf energy disruption raise reopening-gap sensitivity, while the weekend NQ closure prevents live confirmation of persistent one-way Nasdaq structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold. Stress is extreme from Gulf energy risk and higher-rate repricing, with no live NQ path available during the weekend closure.
headline: Weekend gap risk keeps closed-market Nasdaq regime at WATCH
body: NQ is closed. The reported strike on an Iranian tanker near Kharg Island adds discontinuity risk; Friday's stronger payroll report lifted Treasury yields while the Nasdaq finished lower. Fresh shared Finviz context is mixed latest-session evidence and is treated only as supplementary, not as live NQ price-path proof.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours include Friday's post-payroll repricing, two brief orange Tail episodes during live trading, the transition into weekend closure, and a return to WATCH after the Kharg tanker-strike report. Since NQ closed, Tail has been driven by discontinuity risk rather than observed persistent mean-reversion failure.
outlookSummary: NQ remains closed throughout this 24-hour horizon. If no additional verified Gulf escalation or material shipping deterioration appears, Tail is projected to ease gradually within WATCH as the Kharg shock ages; Stress remains extreme from conflict, energy costs and rate pressure while confidence declines as Friday's live evidence becomes older.
